title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
abstract: arXiv:2608.12220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Supervised RL Training). Specifically, we design a structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework that explicitly models 3D environmental perception to ensure robust spatial understanding and reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a novel RL algorithm featuring multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimation method, facilitating fine-grained credit assignment across distinct segments of the reasoning trajectory. translated_title: SCOUT：通过结构化思维链与多目标过程奖励解锁增强的空间推理能力
translated_abstract: 现有视觉语言模型（VLMs）在稳健的空间推理方面表现出关键瓶颈。最近的强化学习（RL）方法旨在通过可验证的结果来缩小这一差距，但它们在中间推理步骤中的信用分配方面存在不足。同时，结构化推理方法忽视了全面3D理解所必需的深度感知。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了SCOUT（利用过程监督RL训练的结构化思维链）。具体来说，我们设计了一个结构化思维链（CoT）框架，显式建模3D环境感知，以确保稳健的空间理解和推理。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的RL算法，该算法具有多目标过程奖励和定制的优势估计方法，促进了对推理轨迹不同段的细粒度信用分配。为支持我们的框架...
tldr: 本文提出SCOUT框架，通过结构化思维链显式建模3D环境感知，并结合多目标过程奖励的RL算法，实现了细粒度的信用分配，从而显著增强了视觉语言模型的空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SCOUT framework, which explicitly models 3D environmental perception via structured chain-of-thought and combines a multi-objective process reward RL algorithm for fine-grained credit assignment, significantly enhancing spatial reasoning in vision-language models.
